turns.q: I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
turns.replyTail: lore: - Dental insurance: Your plan may help cover up to $3,000 of orthodontic treatment. - HSA or FSA funds: You may be able to use pre-tax dollars toward treatment. - Financing or payment plans: Many Invisalign® providers offer plans that spread out the cost; your provider can review what is available. Invisalign® treatment is often priced similarly to braces, while offering clear, removable aligners that make it easier to eat, brush, and maintain your usual oral-care routine during treatment.
